Chapter 497: Chapter 4 Breaking the Myth (Please Subscribe)_2

Therefore, White Light Star Master’s combat power may be inferior to that of an Eighth Layer invincible, but in terms of escaping tactics, not even an Eighth Layer invincible could match him.

The greatest strength of an Eighth Layer invincible lies in Cosmic Force, but Cosmic Force is just one type of power. Unless someone is adept at using Cosmic Force to escape, they’re truly no match for White Light Star Master.

After completing the transaction of the Thunder Heart with Lin Yuan, White Light Star Master mentioned this to Chikun Star Lord, who then requested that White Light Star Master stay outside the Milky Way Main Star for a while longer, to protect Lin Yuan’s safety.

“Five Eighth Layer invincibles?”

White Light Star Master’s expression changed slightly. Had it been just one or two Eighth Layer invincibles trying to assassinate Lin Yuan, he would have been able to help, as long as Lin Yuan could hold on for an instant.

But five Eighth Layer invincibles…

...

Even if these five Eighth Layer invincibles were not as adept at Space Rules as he was, a quantitative change could lead to a qualitative change, and his task would no longer be to flee, but to rescue Lin Yuan and then flee.

“It looks like I have no choice but to use that treasure,” White Light Star Master raised his right hand, and a bunch of white flames started to burn.

Human Civilization, as a Peak Clan, had countless treasures, and White Light Star Master, being a seasoned Eighth Layer Peak, naturally possessed many such trump cards.

The white flames burning in his hand were a one-time treasure that, once activated, would unleash power close to the Ninth Rank’s foundational might.

It was sufficient to temporarily fend off those five Eighth Layer invincibles.

However, in the next moment.

With a single thought, Lin Yuan crushed the joint assassination attempt by the five Eighth Layer invincibles and effortlessly repelled four of them, leaving White Light Star Master somewhat stunned.

What just happened?

Wasn’t Galaxy Master in dire straits?

How had the situation changed before he even made a move to help?

…

“Eighth Layer invincibles… let’s go…”

Outside the Milky Way Main Star, now certain that Lin Yuan had grasped a kind of Cosmic Force, Dark Scale Race Sarath made a prompt decision to leave.

Setting aside that the Cosmic Force Lin Yuan had realized exceeded the power of normal advanced Cosmic Forces, even if it were just an ordinary Cosmic Force, their plan had failed.

Even the most ordinary Cosmic Force is still Cosmic Force, and with Galaxy Master having grasped such power, he had become an Eighth Layer invincible of their own level.

The five of them, Eighth Layer invincibles, could indeed suppress one of their own when joining forces, but it was merely suppression; to completely render an Eighth Layer invincible powerless to resist and to inject ‘Memory Poison’ into them was unquestionably a fool’s dream.

Given the circumstances, any further delay would be just a waste of time. Should other powerful beings of Human Civilization arrive, leaving would come at a cost.

“Did I say you could leave?”

Lin Yuan stood under the starry sky, looking towards the five retreating Eighth Layer invincibles.

At the same time.

The vague black and white power of Yin Yang Taiji quietly spread and extended in all directions.

“Galaxy Master, do you really think you can keep us here?” Dark Scale Race Sarath was mildly startled and found it somewhat absurd.

The fact that Galaxy Master had grasped Cosmic Force indeed exceeded his expectations, but at most, that meant the mission had failed and he, along with the other four Eighth Layer invincible beings, could retreat unscathed.

They were all Eighth Layer invincibles, and even if the Cosmic Force that Galaxy Master had grasped was stronger than theirs, it was almost impossible to detain them.

Among Eighth Layer invincibles, there certainly were stronger and weaker ones, but the gap would not be huge. One side could not fully defeat the other, let alone kill or detain them.

If Dark Scale Race Sarath was not wary of other powerful beings of Human Civilization arriving soon, he would certainly continue to probe Galaxy Master with the other four Eighth Layer invincibles.

“Forget it.”

“He’s probably just bluffing.”

“There’s no need to take Galaxy Master’s words to heart.”

Dark Scale Race Sarath reined in his thoughts and began to accelerate his departure from the Milky Way Star Region.

The rustling sound.

Before they had gotten far, Dark Scale Race Sarath sensed the black and white Yin Yang Taiji Power enveloping him from all around.

“The Cosmic Force controlled by Galaxy Master?”

Dark Scale Race Sarath immediately activated his power of shifting sands to defend himself.

Clearly.

Galaxy Master had caught up with them.

Yet, Dark Scale Race Sarath was not particularly afraid, knowing that while he might be inferior to Galaxy Master, at worst, he would be suppressed; not even restricted from fleeing.

However.

Before long.

In Dark Scale Race Sarath’s perception, alongside the black and white Yin Yang Taiji Power, a new force emerged.

This force was immeasurable and boundless, infinite and unending.

“Another cosmic force? Or is it a higher cosmic force?”

The Dark Scale Race Sarath was shocked and a sense of crisis rose in his heart.

“This Milky Way Star Master controls two cosmic forces, and both are higher cosmic forces?” The Dark Scale Race Sarath faintly felt a great terror.

The next moment.

An aura that could destroy all things swept over, and the Dark Scale Race Sarath was again terrified.

“The third higher cosmic force?”

“This Milky Way Star Master…”

Fear flashed in the eyes of the Dark Scale Race Sarath, his form began to dissolve, and his consciousness fell into darkness.

Lin Yuan stood where the form of the Dark Scale Race Sarath had dissolved, caught his space bracelet, and took it into his inner world.

With the power of Yin-Yang Taiji, Immeasurable Force, and the power of destruction, three types of higher cosmic forces that could complement each other, and augmented by the power of the world extending from his inner world that spanned millions of miles.

Lin Yuan’s combat power had grown significantly beyond that of a typical Eighth Rank Invincible, so killing the Dark Scale Race Sarath was not difficult.

This was still Lin Yuan holding back greatly, merely revealing three cosmic forces; the dozens of other cosmic forces had not even been used, let alone that thread of Primal Force that surpassed higher cosmic forces.

…

In a star domain deep in the universe.

The original body of the Dark Scale Race Sarath suddenly opened his eyes.

“That Milky Way Star Master?!”

The expression of the Dark Scale Race Sarath was full of horror. Being an Eighth Rank Invincible himself, he naturally had an avatar, and it was this avatar that usually roamed outside.

After all, even an Eighth Rank Invincible was not absolutely safe, as encountering certain powerful Ninth Rank beings would mean death for an Invincible.

The Dark Scale Race Sarath had thought that his avatar might perish, but he never expected to die at the hands of another human Eighth Rank Evolver.

“How is that Milky Way Star Master so strong? To have discerned three higher cosmic forces?”

The Dark Scale Race Sarath shuddered, vaguely feeling that something was not right. If it were just three higher cosmic forces, even if they could kill him, they shouldn’t have ‘instantly killed’ him as they did just now. Obviously, there was another powerful force beyond those three cosmic forces.

“Milky Way Star Master… the Insect Race is going to have a headache….” The Dark Scale Race Sarath thought silently to himself.

Although he lost an avatar, a heavy loss indeed, based on the performance just now, the Milky Way Star Master would probably become a major problem for the Insect Race.

“Also… the myth of the Eighth Rank Invincibility… has been broken…”

The expression of the Dark Scale Race Sarath was complex.

…

Milky Way Star Master.

Lin Yuan enveloped all directions with the power of Yin-Yang Taiji, aided by the Immeasurable Force and the power of destruction, and soon killed another Eighth Rank Invincible alien being.

“Three got away…”

Lin Yuan glanced in three drastically different directions.

The escape routes of five Eighth Rank Invincibles were naturally inconsistent and scattered.

After Lin Yuan killed two, the other three had already gone far.

Upon witnessing Lin Yuan kill an Eighth Rank Invincible as if slaughtering chickens, these three Eighth Rank Invincible beings from different species were so frightened that they used all kinds of methods to get as far away as possible.

Actually, with Lin Yuan’s current strength, even though he was far from his peak, he could have detained those five Eighth Rank Invincibles.

However, it would inevitably reveal more cosmic forces.

Having control of dozens of cosmic forces, including the Primal Force that surpassed higher cosmic forces, should belong to his secret trump cards.

To expose them just to kill a few Eighth Rank Invincibles was, Lin Yuan felt, not worth it.

It was not even really a killing; Lin Yuan could sense that the two Eighth Rank Invincibles he had ‘killed’ were still causally linked to him, which meant they hadn’t truly died, likely their original selves were still alive.

“Although the combat power of an Eighth Rank Invincible is on the same level as a Supreme Immortal King in the Spirit Realm, in terms of escape techniques, they far surpass the latter…”

Lin Yuan looked thoughtful.

As for the reason, it was not hard to understand. In the Spirit Realm, Supreme Immortal Kings were practically at the ceiling, but in the Main World, an Eighth Rank Invincible was not even at the top.

Therefore, Eighth Rank Invincibles placed great importance on life-saving techniques and most of them had strong backgrounds and could receive gifts from more powerful beings.

This was far beyond what Supreme Immortal Kings in the Spirit Realm could compare to.
